title: First classified tour on Eleuthera, Bahamas, with an air-rescue cover

tellings.quote: I was on a Luther in the Bahamas

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest of podcast host Jesse Michels, says his first secret military posting, in the 1960s, was an 18-month tour on Eleuthera, an island in the Bahamas. He says the work there was hidden behind a cover story of air-sea rescue, and he tells it as the start of a career spent inside classified government work.
